versions.localizedDescription:
**Dusklight for Apple Vision Pro** — The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess, rendered natively on **Metal** (no emulator, no translation layer), including a world-locked **stereoscopic 3D mode**.

Ships with **no game content** — you supply your own **GameCube Twilight Princess disc image** (US `GZ2E01` or European/PAL `GZ2P01`, as `.iso` or `.rvz`). Drop it in via Files at first launch; it's read in place and never leaves your device.

### Install via SideStore source (recommended — auto-updates)
Add one URL to [SideStore](https://sidestore.io) and it installs *and updates itself* when new versions ship:

- **Apple Vision Pro:** `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rebelancap/dusklight-ios/main/sidestore/apps-visionos.json`

First install SideStore onto the headset with my [iloader fork](https://github.com/rebelancap/iloader/releases#release-visionos) (runs on an Apple Silicon Mac, pairs over Wi-Fi — no cable, no Dev Strap), then add the source.

### Or download and sideload manually
- **`dusklight-1.0.0-visionOS.ipa`** — Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 2+), 2D + 3D in one app

### What's in it
- The **full Twilight Princess**, rendered natively on Metal (GX → aurora → Dawn/WebGPU → Metal), with GameCube memory-card saves
- **Runtime disc loading** — the disc image is read in place; no PC tools, no extraction
- **Game controllers**, and **60 / 90 / 120 Hz** (auto-detects your headset's panel)
- A **free-resizing 2D window** at high resolution
- **Stereoscopic 3D mode** — the game on a world-locked panel floating in your room, with **foveated rendering** (as crisp as the flat 2D window, sharpest where you look), **spatial audio anchored to the screen**, and live-tunable **stereo depth**, **screen size / distance / height** (any aspect renders true widescreen FOV, no stretching), **surroundings dimming**, and Digital Crown **recenter**
- **Dolphin-format HD/4K texture packs** via drag-and-drop in Files

Full instructions in the [README](https://github.com/rebelancap/dusklight-ios#readme).
